title: From Alert Floods to Precedence Forests: Zero-Prior-Knowledge Incident Triage with LOGOS
abstract: arXiv:2610.02297v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Commercial observability platforms rely on domain artifacts like distributed traces, topology maps, and baseline metrics. However, when troubleshooting proprietary software, enterprise operators are left with only raw, unannotated text logs. We explore the extreme boundary of log-only diagnosis: To what extent can we isolate failure propagation using strictly raw text logs? We present LOGOS, an unsupervised system that exploits entity-event co-occurrence and temporal precedence to collapse millions of raw log lines into a compact precedence forest. Evaluated across 25 production enterprise outages and 12 open-source issues, LOGOS operates with zero prior knowledge---requiring no seed queries, observed symptoms, or pre-defined incident boundaries. In a median wall-time of 4.5 minutes, LOGOS eliminates a median 99.8% of background noise, achieves 0.76 mean recall, and detects failure cascades with a 16-hour median diagnosis-verified lead

translated_title: 从告警洪流到先序森林：基于LOGOS的零先验知识事件分诊
translated_abstract: 商业可观测性平台依赖于分布式追踪、拓扑图和基线指标等领域制品。然而，在排查专有软件故障时，企业运维人员手中往往只有原始的、无标注的文本日志。我们探索了仅日志诊断的极端边界：在严格只使用原始文本日志的条件下，我们能在多大程度上隔离故障传播？我们提出了LOGOS，这是一个无监督系统，它利用实体-事件共现和时间先序关系，将数百万行原始日志压缩为紧凑的先序森林。在25次生产环境企业故障和12个开源问题的评估中，LOGOS在零先验知识条件下运行——不需要种子查询、观测到的症状或预定义的事件边界。在中位数4.5分钟的实际耗时内，LOGOS消除了中位数99.8%的背景噪音，达到0.76的平均召回率，并以中位数16小时的提前量检测到故障级联（经诊断验证）。
tldr: LOGOS是一个零先验知识的无监督事件分诊系统，仅通过挖掘原始文本日志中的实体-事件共现和时间先序关系，将海量日志压缩为先序森林，能在约4.5分钟内消除99.8%的背景噪音，并以16小时的中位数提前量检测到故障级联。
en_tdlr: LOGOS is a zero-prior-knowledge unsupervised incident triage system that collapses massive raw text logs into compact precedence forests by exploiting entity-event co-occurrence and temporal precedence, eliminating 99.8% of background noise within a median of 4.5 minutes and detecting failure cascades with a 16-hour median diagnosis-verified lead time.
